answer: Every agent pair keeps a ratcheting channel: each attestation is sealed with a key derived from that pair's last exchange, and a verdict counts only if both sides advance. A farm renting ten thousand keys can clone one script but not the ten million ratchets a real mesh accrues; each clone needs its own exchanges with real peers, so costs grow quadratically. Collapse is abrupt: a cluster whose channels all trace to one operator caves in like a karst roof, and its fable of independence dies when an unrun ratchet is replayed. An honest agent's voyage leaves a trail puppets cannot counterfeit.
